items.title: A little order never hurts
items.text: I’ve always liked having my things organized and easy to find, even in my room. I’m usually the one who enjoys organizing hangouts with friends and making sure everyone knows what’s happening. I naturally enjoy creating order and making things easier for everyone, which also comes in handy in my work.

items.title: I always try to make it work
items.text: I wouldn’t call myself a perfectionist, but I like things to be well put together especially when I'm determined in achieving a goal. Whether it’s keeping my schoolwork up to date or making sure things are in order at home, I like knowing everything is handled properly.

items.title: Always up for something new
items.text: I enjoy trying new foods, discovering new things, and figuring out what I like along the way. I think that curiosity also shows up in how I approach new tools and tasks, I’m usually excited to learn how something works.
